quests.title: Orobashi's Legacy: Part II

dialogue.t: The strange stone lantern seems to emit an ominous energy.
This stone lantern is so creepy... It feels familiar.
Oh, someone's written something on the lantern post!
"Soldiers stationed here, if you have any questions about this ward, please go to the Musoujin Gorge and talk to Mr. Kaji."
The handwriting looks new, yet eroded by rain. A few clear lines of smaller writings are below.
"Please don't believe these strange notes. We've got no time to lose! This must an enemy trick meant to slow us down."
"Whoever leaves the team without permission will be severely punished!"
This Mr. Kaji seems to be pretty concerned about these stone lanterns. Why don't we go to Musoujin Gorge and ask him?
The lantern has finally been repaired. The weather seems to have changed as well.
Something seems to be missing from this ward. Let's try to find it with Elemental Sight, shall we?
It seems that two critical components are missing from the ward.

quests.description: A rock pillar stands sentinel at the Serpent’s Head, waiting silently for someone to come to repair it…
